newsitem.title: USA: PaineWebber unit files $500 mln shelf.
newsitem.headline: PaineWebber unit files $500 mln shelf.

text.p: PaineWebber Mortgage Acceptance Corp IV, a financing unit of PaineWebber Group Inc, filed Wednesday with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to register a shelf offering of up to $500 million in asset-backed certificates and notes.

The asset-backed securities will represent an ownership interest in a pool of various types of single-family and multi-family residential mortgages, home improvement contracts, cooperative apartment loans or manufacturered housing sales contracts.
PaineWebber Inc was listed as the underwriter for the shelf offering.
